claims.claim: The Hebcal holiday query requires month=x and i=on; month=now is invalid and returns an empty items array, and omitting i=on returns the Diaspora calendar
claims.note: Live comparison. month=now returns verbatim {"title":"Hebcal Diaspora 2026","location":{"geo":"none"},"items":[]} (HTTP 200, zero items, so a yomtov gate never fires). month=x without i=on returns 'Hebcal Diaspora 2026' with 13 yomtov days; with i=on returns 'Hebcal Israel 2026' with 8. The five extra Diaspora days (Pesach II, Pesach VIII, Shavuot II, Sukkot II, Simchat Torah) are ordinary working days in Israel. An Israeli geonameid has the same effect as i=on.

claims.claim: n8n 2.x blocks Code-node environment variable access by default (N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=true) and restricts require() unless NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN / NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL are set
claims.note: Breaking-changes page verbatim: 'To improve security, n8n will block access to environment variables from the Code node by default. The default value for N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE is now set to true.' Module docs verbatim: 'External module support is disabled when an environment variable isn't set' and 'If n8n instance is setup with Task Runners, add the environment variables to the Task Runners instead to the main n8n node.'

claims.claim: The Israel Invoice Reform allocation-number threshold is measured before VAT (lifnei maam)
claims.note: Source verbatim: 'הסכום אותו קבעה רשות המיסים לא כולל מע"מ'. Threshold table: May 2024 25,000; Jan 2025 20,000; Jan 2026 10,000; Jun 2026 onwards 5,000.
